requirements.description: Provide a Python module calc.py with a function add(a, b) that returns the sum of a and b.
requirements.source: Provide a Python module `calc.py` with `add(a, b)` returning the sum.

requirements.description: Provide a function divide(a, b) in calc.py that returns a / b and raises ValueError when b is zero.
requirements.source: `calc.divide(a, b)` returns a / b and raises `ValueError` when b is zero.

requirements.description: Include unit tests using unittest in the tests/ directory covering both add and divide functions, including the error case for divide.
requirements.source: Include unit tests (unittest) in `tests/` covering both functions, including the error case.
